description: This file defines the RequestForwardableException class, a custom exception implementing HttpExceptionInterface, used within the OrangeHRM system for handling request forwarding errors with additional context such as controller, attributes, query, status code, and headers.

classes.name: RequestForwardableException
classes.description: A custom exception class for request forwarding errors, holding controller, attributes, query, status code, and headers, and implementing HttpExceptionInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with controller, attributes, and query parameters.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the controller associated with the exception.

methods.name: setController
methods.description: Sets the controller associated with the exception.
